Product Information

An eye cream with Retinol clinically proven to address 3 major eye area concerns: lines, dark circles, and puffiness.

This Retinol eye cream is clinically proven to address multiple eye area concerns. Designed with Patented Clinical Retinol, RoC’s® best eye cream for wrinkles treats lines, dark circles, and puffiness in the delicate eye area.

Designed for dramatic results but gentle enough for daily use around your eyes, crow’s feet are visibly reduced by 50%. 90% saw dark circles visibly reduced, while 84% saw reduced puffiness.

Award Winning Formula | Allure's Best in Beauty 2025: Best Line Smoothing Eye Cream
Award Winning Formula | Marie Claire's Skin Awards 2023: Best Eye Cream Under $50

Use the RETINOL CORREXION® Line Smoothing Eye Cream after cleansing and follow with a serum and moisturizer to help support hydration and ease your skin into a retinol eye routine. For experienced retinol users, layer RETINOL CORREXION® Line Smoothing Eye Cream with a retinol serum and moisturize to enhance the look of smoothed lines, wrinkles, and crow's feet as part of your complete age-defying routine.

KEY INGREDIENTS

PATENTED CLINICAL RETINOL

Not all retinoids are created equal. Backed by 30+ years of expertise & 26 patents, Patented Clinical Retinol uses proprietary technology clinically proven to be 7x more effective than standard Retinol to deliver rapid results with continued improvement even after 1 year. Safe for year-round use on all skin types.

Hyaluronic Acid

Hyaluronic Acid is a naturally-occurring molecule essential for skin’s hydration with the ability to attract water to your skin. Like a sponge, it locks in moisture for a visibly plump, smooth and healthy appearance.

"Simplicity at its finest, time-released retinol is perfectly balanced giving dramatic results without the irritation."
– Dr. Luke Maxfield, Board-Certified Dermatologist

Product Information

product directions

Apply small dots around the eye area and gently smooth until thoroughly absorbed. Use in the AM or PM.

With consistent AM + PM use, this product is designed to last ~2–3 months.

Subscribe & Save 10% to get free recurring deliveries to ensure you never run out.

introducing retinol to your routine

Retinol is a powerful ingredient, so it is important that new users slowly introduce it to their skin to build tolerance and avoid any negative reactions.

Begin applying this product every other night and then gradually increase frequency of use to every night. Always apply a sunscreen of SPF 30 or higher in the AM while using this product. 

Users should introduce one Retinol product at a time to their skincare routine. Once a tolerance to one Retinol product is built, you can add additional Retinol products to your routine if you wish. When introducing the next Retinol product, follow the same steps as before to build additional tolerance.

Note: If your skin shows a reaction, such as redness or a dry patch, take a break from Retinol usage for a few days until the reaction subsides. Then, reintroduce Retinol into your routine using a slower frequency. If symptoms continue, stop using product and consult a physician.

For more in-depth guidance, explore our Retinol Guide.

Aqua (Water/Eau), Lactose, Glycerin, C12-15 Alkyl Benzoate, Cetearyl Ethylhexanoate, Glyceryl Stearate, PEG100 Stearate, PEG-8, Retinol, Dihydroxy Methylchromone, Sodium Hyaluronate, Magnesium Aspartate, Zinc Gluconate, Copper Gluconate, Panthenol, Tocopherol, Sorbitol, Cetyl Alcohol, Arachidyl Alcohol, Stearyl Alcohol, Isopropyl Myristate, Pentylene Glycol, Carbomer, Polysorbate 20, Hydroxyacetophenone, Tromethamine, Tetrasodium Glutamate Diacetate, Octadecyl Di-t-butyl-4-hydroxyhydrocinnamate, 1,2 Hexanediol, Caprylyl Glycol.
